open_points.subject: _transport_log_record
open_points.text: MUST return exactly four labelled fields, each written as label=value and separated by single spaces, in the order rid (the request id), method, path and status, so an operator log parser does not change between builds.
open_points.other_text: The path value is the canonical_path argument exactly as given, which the caller already took from _canonical_path over the request path without its query string: the function MUST NOT truncate, shorten, escape, encode, redact or otherwise inspect it, so the ids a route path carries appear in the record as they are, and a control character such as a newline that the server decoded into the path is written unchanged.
open_points.question: Must path whitespace and control characters be escaped to preserve the four-field, single-space-delimited record format, or must they remain unchanged even though they can introduce additional separators or record lines?
